title: SliceContract
description: Validates the YAML frontmatter of templates/slice-contract.md

story.description: Story ID and title — e.g. 'US-001: Add candidate CRUD'

allowed_files.description: Complete list of files this slice is allowed to touch — agent must not modify files outside this list

blast_radius.description: LOW=≤5 files/isolated, MEDIUM=6-15 files/1-2 layers, HIGH=15+/migrations/auth

rollback.description: Exact git command or step to undo this slice

depends_on.description: List of story IDs or phase names that must be complete before this slice starts

evidence_required.description: List of commands or checks that must pass before marking this slice DONE

approved_by.description: Human who approved the contract. Required by verify.mjs when blast_radius is HIGH. A record, not an identity proof: enforce with CODEOWNERS + required review.
